headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 7 studies yielded an overall effect size of 1.57 (95% CI: 1.23–1.99), suggesting that monounsaturated fat (mufa) is associated with a higher risk of prostate cancer. However, this association should be interpreted with caution, as there was very high between-study heterogeneity (I² = 86.43%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
